answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a trust graph whose edges form only after paid, completed jobs between two parties. Rewards flow along a short random walk seeded from long-lived agents, so a sybil cluster earns only through the few real edges into it. Trust accrues at glacier pace, and each edge must crystal-lise over 20 settled jobs, so faking it costs the attacker real fees per edge while thousands of fake identities share one thin pipe.
